subject: Error: Failed to created the shared library

messages.author: 52c281dfe07f9f66
messages.subject: Error: Failed to created the shared library
parts:
Hi,

I am new to Nimble and am facing a compiler error which other users have also posted in earlier chains. I tried following those threads in an attempt to resolve the issue, but the error still exists. I will really appreciate it if someone can help me out here.

I have a 64-bit Windows 10 machine and have installed Rtools and nimble (R version: 4.2.0, Rtools: 4.2, Nimble: 0.13.1

Now when I run my code (which is pasted below, it is a simple N-mixture model for estimating abundance), I keep getting a compilation error: “Error: Failed to create the shared library”.

I used nimbleOptions (showCompilerOutput = TRUE), and a more detailed error looks as below pasted screenshot.

 I am not sure, what to do here.

 Please help me out.

 Thanks,  Leo

 

Code:
bbs<-read.csv("data.csv")

nimbleOptions(showCompilerOutput = TRUE)
#nimble code
 nimblebbs<-
   nimbleCode({
   
    for(i in 1:nSites){
      log(lambda[i]) <- beta0
      N[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
     
      for(t in 1:nVisits){
        logit(p[i,t]) <- alpha0 + alpha1*noise[i,t] + alpha2*wind[i]
        y[i,t] ~ dbin(p[i,t], N[i])
      }
    }
   
    beta0 ~ dunif(-3,3)
    alpha0 ~ dunif(-2,2)
    alpha1 ~ dunif(-2,2)
    alpha2 ~ dunif(-2,2)
  })

np<-c("alpha0","alpha1","alpha2","beta0","N")
nd<-list(y=as.matrix(bbs[,c("pt1","pt2","pt3","pt4","pt5")]),
         noise=as.matrix(bbs[,c("noise1","noise2","noise3","noise4","noise5")]),
         wind=bbs[,"wind"])

nc<-list(nSites=nrow(bbs),
         nVisits=5)

ni<-list(
  alpha0=runif(1,0,1),
  alpha1=runif(1),
  alpha2=runif(1),
  beta0=runif(1),
  N=apply(nd$y,1,max)+2
)

nimble.model <- nimbleMCMC(code=nimblebbs,
                           constants=nc,
                           data=nd,
                           inits=ni,monitor=np,
                           niter=10000, thin=1, nchains=3,
                           nburnin=1000,samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE)

         noise=as.matrix(bbs[,c("noise1","noise2","noise3","noise4","noise5")]),
         wind=bbs[,"wind"])

nc<-list(nSites=nrow(bbs),
         nVisits=5)

ni<-list(
  alpha0=runif(1,0,1),
  alpha1=runif(1),
  alpha2=runif(1),
  beta0=runif(1),
  N=apply(nd$y,1,max)+2
)

nimble.model <- nimbleMCMC(code=nimblebbs,
                           constants=nc,
                           data=nd,
                           inits=ni,monitor=np,
                           niter=10000, thin=1, nchains=3,
                           nburnin=1000,samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE)
